     plugin/test/sync-repo-allow-list.test.mjs ties sync-repo's list to it, and checks it against the tag where the tag exists. -->

<!-- plugin/HARNESS.md, "Permissions for an unattended run": lines 87-100 -->
run's allow-list goes in the repo's `.claude/settings.json` (`permissions.allow`), or in
`.claude/settings.local.json` for one person. Each entry of run's list ("Unattended prerequisites") is one rule, with
`<cli>` and `<server>` from `.sdlc/leeway.md`:

| run's list names | The rule |
|---|---|
| a Leeway verb | `Bash(<cli> --server <server> <verb> *)`, for example `Bash(leeway --server https://app.leeway.run spend record *)` |
| a git verb | `Bash(git -C * <verb> *)`, for example `Bash(git -C * commit *)` |
| a lane or setup command | `Bash(<command> *)`, one rule per part of a compound lane |
| `node -e` | `Bash(node -e *)` |
| `gh pr create`, `gh pr view` | `Bash(gh pr create *)`, `Bash(gh pr view *)` |
| the three scripts | `Bash(leeway-sdlc-wait-answer *)`, `Bash(leeway-sdlc-session-tokens *)`, `Bash(leeway-sdlc-raise *)` |
| file edits under `.worktrees/` | `Edit(/.worktrees/**)`, which also covers the `Write` tool |
| the plugin's own files | `Read(~/.claude/plugins/cache/*/leeway-sdlc/**)` |

<!-- plugin/skills/run/SKILL.md, "Unattended prerequisites": lines 1188-1195, the verbs the table's two verb rows take -->
  - **Leeway verbs:** `issue get`, `issue list`, `issue update`, `issue create`, `comment add`, `iteration record`,
    `spend record`, `escalation list`, `clarification answer`, `clarification list`, `review get`,
    `project get`, `project link`, `process get`.
    Any other verb prompts: `escalation raise` (a run raises through `<raise>`), `escalation answer`, `issue delete`, `product delete`, `process update`, and any verb a later
    CLI adds. A run calls none of them. A subagent is stopped from the write verbs by the plugin's
    `leeway-guard` hook, not by the allow-list, and the hook is not a vault (`PROCESS.md`, "The cast").
  - **git verbs,** each as `git -C <absolute path> <verb>` and at least one argument: `add`, `commit`, `push`, `fetch`, `merge`, `merge-base`,
    `worktree`, `branch -d`, `ls-remote`, `rev-parse`, `diff`, `status`, `show`, `log`, `blame`.
